svg.title: Goals and key results, linked to the epics that serve them — SoftTrack web design mockup (#284)
svg.desc: An epic says what is being built; why, and how anybody will know it worked, is in a slide from the start of the quarter. A goal has an owner and a period, key results with a start, a target and a current value, and links to the epics that serve it; goals nest from team to department to organisation.
svg.text: Goals and key results, linked to the epics that serve them
· why, and how anybody will know it worked

g.text: Customers answer their own billing questions
The portal is live for three customers
Sign in and see invoices, on production
Billing tickets to support fall by half
Payroll closes in two days, not five

svg.text: Done when a goal has a title, an owner and a period and belongs to the organisation, a department or a team; key results are numbers with a start, a target and a current value or
the progress of linked epics; epics and initiatives link to a goal; the owner checks in with a note and the history is kept; goals nest; everyone signed in except external accounts
reads them; and a goal is closed with an outcome.
